zh: (1974-1993) a black British teenager who was murdered in South London in 1993 by a group of teenagers. Although several men were charged with his murder, two trials were stopped because there was not enough evidence. In 1997, there was a public inquiry into the case and, as a result, in 1999 the Macpherson Report criticized police for racism (= unfair treatment of people who belong to a different race) in dealing with Stephen's murder and recommended changes to the police in Britain. In 2012, two men, Gary Dobson and David Norris, were found guilty of Lawrence's murder.

zh: 爱打听的人；好探听隐私的人；包打听
en: to try to find out information about other people's private lives in a way that is annoying or rude
ex: I don't mean to stickybeak, but when is he going to leave?
我不是要多管闲事，但是他什么时候要离开呢？

zh: 不易弯曲（或活动）的；硬的；挺的
困难的；艰难的；严厉的；激烈的
en: difficult to bend or move
ex: a sheet of stiff black cardboard
一张黑色硬纸板

en: to push away a player who is trying to stop you, with your arm straight
proud and refusing to change

zh: （尤指因气愤或害怕，使浑身或身体的一部分）变僵硬，变僵直，绷紧
en: to make yourself or part of your body straight and still, especially because you are angry or frightened
ex: She stiffened with fear.
她吓呆了。

zh: in a slow and uncomfortable way
不易弯曲（或活动）的；硬的；挺的
en: in a way that is formal, and not friendly or relaxed
ex: ‘Thank you,’ she replied stiffly.
“谢谢。”她坚定地回答。

zh: difficulty in moving because of pain in your muscles
不易弯曲（或活动）的；硬的；挺的
困难的；艰难的；严厉的；激烈的
en: difficulty in moving because of pain in your muscles
ex: pain and stiffness in her legs
她两腿又疼又僵的感觉

en: an erection of a man’s penis

zh: （使）窒息，无法自如地呼吸，感觉窒闷
en: to prevent something from happening; to prevent a feeling from being expressed
ex: She managed to stifle a yawn.
她忍住了哈欠。

zh: （使）窒息，无法自如地呼吸，感觉窒闷
making you feel trapped and unable to do or say what you want
en: making you feel unable to breathe, because it is too hot and/or there is no fresh air
ex: a stifling room
闷得让人透不过气来的房间

zh: （使）窒息，无法自如地呼吸，感觉窒闷
en: in a way that makes you feel unable to breathe, because it is too hot and/or there is no fresh air
ex: The room was stiflingly hot.
房间里热得人喘不上气来。

en: negative feelings that people have about particular circumstances or characteristics that somebody may have
ex: the social stigma of alcoholism
酗酒在社会上的恶名

zh: 圣伤，圣痕（据信出现在某些圣徒身上，与耶稣身上钉子留下的伤痕相似）
en: marks that look like the wounds made by nails on the body of Jesus Christ, believed by some Christians to have appeared as holy marks on the bodies of some saints
